headline: Garanti BBVA Secures €400 Million International Financing Facility
summary: Turkish private lender Garanti BBVA closed a €400 million international loan agreement to support cross-border commercial transactions.
why: Garanti BBVA is one of Turkey's largest commercial banks, reliant on international syndicated loans to fund domestic foreign currency lending.

impacts.name: Turkiye Garanti Bankasi AS
impacts.why: Securing international bank debt reinforces liquidity and funding stability for trade financing.
